spec.kitLine: Crafts 1 homemade magazine, up to a max
spec.scope: resource machinery (Scrap pool -> magazine counter), self only
spec.durationSemantics: continuous/permanent — magazines persist once crafted; kit never states they are consumed
spec.triggerIdentity: resource-threshold: fires when Scrap pool reaches 10 AND magazines < 4 (pre-consume check); consumes the 10 Scraps on fire. On the control comp this fires exactly once, at t=0, off skill2's start-of-battle +10
spec.nearestWrongModel: Magazines assumed at the 4-stack cap (or ramping to 4 over the fight) — 'up to a maximum of 4' read as the steady state instead of the ceiling. With no scrap income on a partless solo boss, 4 is unreachable
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On controlComp('e-h'), the magazine count (resource pool or atkPct stack count) equals 1 for the ENTIRE 180s — no buffApply for the skill1 ATK line ever shows stacks>1 or a second application after t~0
spec.inertness: No re-craft events after t=0; magazine count must never exceed 1 on the control comp

spec.scope: generic self ATK (atkPct — scales own ATK), no attack-type scoping
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = permanent while magazines are held — NO durationSec; value scales linearly with magazine count
spec.triggerIdentity: applied on craft (skill1 activation); effectively a passive from t~0 at 1 magazine on this boss
spec.nearestWrongModel: Authored at max-stacks magnitude: atkPct 30 (7.5 x 4) as a flat passive, or 7.5 with maxStacks:4 assumed filled — over-credits ATK by ~22.5 points all fight. Secondary misread: giving it a durationSec so it lapses
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Event log shows buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 7.5 (stacks 1) on e-h with no expiresFrame (or expiry >= fight length), and NO buffApply at value 30 / stacks 4 anywhere in the run
spec.inertness: Must not exceed one 7.5% stack on the control comp; must not expire mid-fight

spec.scope: self weapon swap: charge weapon, per-shot 61% of final ATK, full-charge 250% OF THAT DAMAGE (=152.5% per full-charge shot), chargeTime 0.4s, maxAmmo = 1 x magazines (=1 on control comp), 10s window
spec.durationSemantics: 10 s hard cap OR all rounds fired, whichever first — with 1 round the swap ends after ONE shot and e-h resumes her base SMG for the rest of the window
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (her own burst) — the swap exists only on rotations SHE bursts; shots land inside the FB window so they take the +50% FB major by timing
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two stacked misreads: (a) maxAmmo fixed at 4 (cap-assumed magazines) -> 4 charged shots per burst instead of 1; (b) 'Full Charge Damage: 250% of damage' read as 250% of ATK instead of 61%x2.5=152.5%. Also plausible: ignoring the all-rounds-fired deactivation so the swap fires at SMG cadence for the full 10s at 61%/shot
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Per e-h burstCast on controlComp, the event log contains EXACTLY ONE swap/charge-bucket damage event from her, with mult consistent with 61x2.5 (~152.5% of final ATK, under the live 430.05% buff), followed by resumed normal-bucket SMG shots inside the same 10s
spec.inertness: Never more than 1 swap round per cast on the control comp; no swap damage on rotations where helm (not e-h) casts the B3

spec.scope: generic self ATK (atkPct), applies to swap shot AND her SMG fire inside the window
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10 from her cast — wall-clock, not rounds
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (self burst block) — NOT fullBurstEnter. This is the divergence the control comp is built to expose: helm is a co-B3, so team FBs occur on rotations e-h did not cast
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter, granting +430.05% ATK on EVERY team Full Burst including helm's rotations — massive over-credit in any multi-B3 comp
spec.distinguishingAssertion: count(buffApply atkPct value 430.05 on e-h) == count(her own burstCast events) and is STRICTLY LESS than count(fullBurstStart events) on controlComp('e-h') with helm=true — green under burstCast, red under fullBurstEnter
spec.inertness: No 430.05% application on FBs chained by helm's burst; buff gone 10s after her cast

notes: EXPECTED SHARED-PRIOR MISREADS, in order of damage moved: (1) THE MAGAZINE-CAP TRAP — 'up to a maximum of 4' invites steady-state-4, but on the scope-lock partless solo boss the ONLY scrap event is the t=0 +10, so exactly 1 magazine exists all fight; that pins skill1 ATK at 7.5% (not 30%) and the burst swap at 1 round (not 4). Every assertion above leans on this derivation — it follows taxonomy rule 10 (derive the trajectory from the kit-stated start/consume/rebuild: start 10, consume 10, rebuild 0). (2) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on the 430.05% — the harness control comp deliberately carries helm as co-B3, so this misread is directly observable as extra buffApply events. (3) 'Full Charge Damage: 250% of damage' is 250% OF the 61% line (152.5% total), not 250% of ATK. (4) The EAD line must be advantage-gated (elementDamagePct), hence INERT vs the harness's Fire boss and expiring at t=15s — a generic attackDamagePct or permanent encoding fails the zero-delta patch assertion. OPEN AMBIGUITY THE DRIVER MUST RECONCILE: the kit never states magazines are CONSUMED by the burst; the literal read (persist, each cast gets ammo = magazine count) is what I asserted. If the driver assumed consumption + re-craft, that is a divergence to surface — though on this boss both readings still yield 1 round on the first cast, consumption would yield 0 rounds on later casts (no scrap income to re-craft), making the swap fire on only the FIRST burst. A distinguishing check: whether the SECOND e-h burst cast produces a swap shot. Prefer encoding the scrap/magazine machinery as engine resources over hardcoding 1 stack, so non-scope-lock bosses with parts/adds stay expressible — but all control-comp assertions must pin the 1-magazine steady state.
